1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein __said diodes are mounted flush against the columnar body surface without intervening optical elements__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said base member comprises a threaded screw base or a bayonet wedge base__.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including __a transparent light dispersing optic element of molded silicone or polycarbonate material overlapping said diodes and bonded directly to the columnar body__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes __a phosphor material selected from rare-earth phosphors or garnet-based phosphors__.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __with uniform angular spacing of approximately 360 degrees divided by the number of diodes__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that each fin is positioned at the midpoint between adjacent diodes__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has a length-to-width ratio of at least 2:1__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and said diodes are positioned at the center of each face__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and each fin extends radially outward by a distance of at least 3 millimeters__.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and each diode is spaced at least 5 millimeters from adjacent corners__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __selected from copper alloys, aluminum alloys, or composite materials with embedded metal particles__.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including __a plurality of individual optic elements, with a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, wherein each optic element is independently removable__.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and includes integrated thermal management features__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes a dimming control circuit__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __by means of internal refractive surfaces or diffusing particles embedded within the optic element material__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body __with each diode positioned at the center of its respective side__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __wherein said lamp has a general A19 outline and said body has a length of approximately 60-70 millimeters__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, __mounting at least one light emitting diode flush against said body surface__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected from 6061-T6 aluminum alloy or copper-based alloys__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __formed during the extrusion process__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and uniform wall thickness of approximately 1-2 millimeters__.
